items.raw_excerpt: Telemetry and SCADA project is set to employ 150 people who will be identifying water leakages.

items.raw_excerpt: Yeah Oktoberfest is cool, but have you ever had an Erdinger Weissbier in its hometown - or seen the festival parade in Rosenheim? Here are five alternative beer festivals to try in the 'Free State' this autumn.
items.summary_en: Oktoberfest is famous but there are other great beer festivals in Bavaria. These five festivals offer cheaper beer and a more local experience. You can enjoy festival parades and traditional brews in towns like Rosenheim.
items.summary_ko: 옥토버페스트는 유명하지만 바바리아에는 다른 훌륭한 맥주 축제도 많습니다. 이 다섯 곳의 축제는 더 저렴한 맥주와 현지적인 경험을 제공합니다. 로센하임 같은 마을에서 축제 퍼레이드와 전통 양조장을 즐길 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Five Bavarian festivals with cheaper beer than Oktoberfest this September

items.raw_excerpt: Prakash Nikam assumes role as Belagavi's new Police Commissioner, vowing to continue initiatives on traffic management and cybercrime.
items.summary_en: Prakash Nikam has become the new police commissioner of Belagavi. He promised to keep working on traffic management and cybercrime.

items.summary_en: Lewis Hamilton drove a Ferrari F40 to start his Italian Grand Prix weekend at Monza. The British driver showed up in style despite extreme heat at the track. It was a dream car he never thought he would get to drive as a boy.
items.summary_ko: 루이스 해밀턴이 이탈리아 그랑프리 주말을 맞아 몬자 서킷에 페라리 F40을 타고 등장했다. 영국 드라이버는 서킷의 폭염 속에서도 스타일리시한 등장을 보여줬다. 그는 어린 시절 꿈에도 생각하지 못했던 드림카를 직접 운전한 셈이다.
items.title_en: Lewis Hamilton arrives at Monza in a Ferrari F40

items.summary_en: A Proastiakos suburban train was immobilized at Aspropyrgos station near Athens due to a technical fault. Around 170 passengers were on the train when it broke down. The incident caused delays on the suburban rail line.
items.summary_ko: 아테네 근교 아스프로피르고스 역에서 기술적 결함으로 인해 광역열차가 멈춰 섰다. 당시 열차에는 승객 약 170명이 탑승해 있었다. 이번 사고로 광역철도 노선에 운행 지연이 발생했다.
items.title_en: Suburban train stranded at Aspropyrgos station with 170 passengers on board

items.title_original: Ακινητοποιήθηκε αμαξοστοιχία του Προαστιακού στον Σταθμό Ασπροπύργου με 170 επιβάτες

items.raw_excerpt: It's not often New Zealanders admit Australia is onto a good thing. Our long-running trans-Tasman rivalry usually revolves around accusing Australians of stealing national cultural icons like Phar Lap, Pavlova or Crowded House.
items.summary_en: A New Zealand writer says the country should adopt official fossil emblems, just as Australia has done. The article points out that New Zealand has amazing prehistoric creatures but has never put them on official symbols. It is a fun idea to celebrate the country's deep natural history.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드 기자가 호주처럼 공식 화석 상징을 도입하자고 제안했다. 뉴질랜드에는 놀라운 선사 시절 생물들이 있지만 아직 공식 상징으로 채택되지 않았다. 이 기사는 뉴질랜드의 깊은 자연 역사를 기념하는 재미있는 아이디어를 소개한다.
items.title_en: New Zealand should celebrate its prehistoric past with fossil emblems
items.title_ko: 뉴질랜드, 화석 상징으로 선사 시절 자랑하자
items.title_original: New Zealand should celebrate its prehistoric past with fossil emblems - RNZ

items.raw_excerpt: Quercus criticised the government's decision to proceed with the construction of a waste incinerator in the Algarve, calling it an anachronistic and inadequate solution for the region's seasonal peaks.
items.summary_en: Quercus, a local environmental group, criticized the government's decision to build a waste incinerator in the Algarve. They called it an outdated and unsuitable solution for the region's seasonal waste peaks.
items.summary_ko: 현지 환경단체 퀘르쿠스가 알가르베에 쓰레기 소각장을 짓기로 한 정부의 결정을 비판했다. 이들은 이 계획이 낡았고 지역의 계절별 쓰레기 배출량에 맞지 않는다고 지적했다.
items.title_en: Environmental group criticizes Algarve waste incinerator plan

items.raw_excerpt: Aviso amarelo de perigo potencial para baixa umidade do ar vale para Mato Grosso do Sul, Goiás, Distrito Federal e sudeste de Mato Grosso.
items.summary_en: A cold front is bringing rain to southeastern Brazil and parts of the central-west region. A yellow warning for potential low humidity is in effect for Mato Grosso do Sul, Goiás, the Federal District, and southeastern Mato Grosso.
